notes.title: SOLVE THE MURDER MYSTERY IN DEAD LINK: PAGES TORN
notes.content:
Phime studio is proud to announce that the new hidden object adventure Dead Link: Pages Torn is out and available on Steam for PC, Mac and Linux platforms. 
Ellen Grace gets a call from her sister Amanda, to visit her. However, when Ellen arrives, she stumbles upon Amanda's dead body. 
A single page torn from Amanda's journal is the clue that will lure Ellen into dangerous game of deception and greed connected to Grace Manor.
